code: project <- function(a, start, steps) {   e <- start   out <- numeric(steps)   for (k in seq_len(steps)) {     out[k] <- sum(a * e)     e <- c(out[k], e[-length(e)])   }   out } steps <- 4 * 48 lead <- seq_len(steps) / 4 par(mar = c(4, 4.2, 0.6, 0.6)) plot(range(lead), c(0, 1), type = "n", xlab = "Lead time (h)", ylab = "Predicted error (m3/s)") for (i in 1:3) {   a <- c(0.9, 0.98, 0.995)[i]   lines(lead, project(a, 1, steps), col = pal[i + 1], lwd = 2) } legend("topright", paste("a =", c(0.9, 0.98, 0.995)), col = pal[2:4], lwd = 2, bty = "n")

code: set.seed(1) n <- 1000 forcing <- data.frame(rain = ifelse(stats::runif(n) < 0.3, stats::rgamma(n, 0.7, scale = 4), 0),                       pet = 0.1) temperature <- 2 + 6 * sin(seq_len(n) / 80) model <- pdm_model(area_km2 = 50) snow <- pack_from_config(pack_presets()) time_per_step <- function(engine, expr) {   old <- options(pdmS7.engine = engine)   on.exit(options(old))   reps <- if (engine == "r") 1 else 50   unname(system.time(for (i in seq_len(reps)) force(expr()))[["elapsed"]]) / reps / n * 1e6 } timings <- rbind(   PDM = c(R = time_per_step("r", function() run_pdm(model, forcing)),           C = time_per_step("auto", function() run_pdm(model, forcing))),   PACK = c(R = time_per_step("r", function() sim_pack(forcing$rain, temperature, snow)),            C = time_per_step("auto", function() sim_pack(forcing$rain, temperature, snow))) ) par(mar = c(4, 5, 1, 1)) barplot(t(timings), beside = TRUE, log = "y", col = pal[c(2, 1)], border = NA,         ylab = "Microseconds per step\n(log scale)", ylim = c(0.2, 5000)) legend("topright", c("R loop", "C core"), fill = pal[c(2, 1)], border = NA, bty = "n",        cex = 0.8) round(timings, 1) #>         R   C #> PDM  1762 2.3 #> PACK  285 1.3

The default model: Pareto soil store, standard recharge, cascade surface, cubic groundwater. p = Params(distribution=0, recharge=0, cmin=0, cmax=140, b=0.4, kg=24, bg=1, st=0,            be=1, fc=1, td=0, qc=0, area_km2=50, dt=1) p.surface = Route(type=0, k1=2, k2=4) p.groundwater = Route(type=1, k=1 / 10000, m=3, rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-10)  n = 48 rain = (ctypes.c_double * n)(*([0.0] * 6 + [4.0] * 6 + [0.0] * 36)) pet = (ctypes.c_double * n)(*([0.1] * n)) length = lib.pdm_state_length(ctypes.byref(p)) state = (ctypes.c_double * length)() q = (ctypes.c_double * n)() q_end = (ctypes.c_double * n)() message = ctypes.create_string_buffer(256)  # Warm start in steady state with 0.8 m3/s, 70 per cent baseflow, then run. assert lib.pdm_state_from_flow(ctypes.byref(p), 0.8, 0.7, 0.5, state, length,                                message, 256) == 0, message.value assert lib.pdm_run(ctypes.byref(p), rain, pet, n, state, length, q, q_end, None,                    message, 256) == 0, message.value print([round(x, 3) for x in q[:12]]) m <- pdm_model(area_km2 = 50) storm <- data.frame(rain = c(rep(0, 6), rep(4, 6), rep(0, 36)), pet = 0.1) round(run_pdm(m, storm, initial_state_from_flow(m, 0.8, 0.7))$output$q_m3s[1:12], 3) #>  [1]  0.796  0.776  0.748  0.718  0.691  0.666  0.955  2.409  4.538  6.846 #> [11]  9.084 11.141

code: basins <- file.path(tempdir(), "basins") set.seed(2024) n <- 24 * 60 time <- seq(as.POSIXct("2023-10-01", tz = "UTC"), by = 3600, length.out = n) truths <- list() for (i in 1:8) {   id <- sprintf("B%02d", i)   folder <- file.path(basins, id)   dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE)   wet <- stats::runif(1, 0.04, 0.09)   forcing <- data.frame(     time = format(time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),     rain = ifelse(stats::runif(n) < wet, stats::rgamma(n, 0.7, scale = stats::runif(1, 2, 4)), 0),     pet = round(stats::runif(1, 0.04, 0.09), 3)   )   truth <- pdm_presets("standard")   truth$area_km2 <- round(stats::runif(1, 10, 200))   truth$fc <- stats::runif(1, 0.9, 1.2)   truth$distribution$cmax <- stats::runif(1, 80, 250)   truth$recharge$kg <- exp(stats::runif(1, log(20), log(300)))   k <- sort(stats::runif(2, 1, 12))   truth$surface$k1 <- k[1]   truth$surface$k2 <- k[2]   truths[[id]] <- truth   # The river is already flowing when the record starts: steady state, not empty stores.   model <- pdm_from_config(truth)   flow <- run_pdm(model, forcing[, c("rain", "pet")],                   initial_state_from_flow(model, truth$area_km2 / 50, 0.7))$output$q_m3s *     exp(stats::rnorm(n, 0, 0.04))   if (id == "B06") forcing$pet[100:110] <- -0.05   data.table::fwrite(forcing, file.path(folder, "forcing.csv"))   data.table::fwrite(data.frame(q_m3s = flow), file.path(folder, "flow.csv"))   writeLines(c(     paste("catchment:", paste("Example", id)),     paste("gauge:", id),     paste("area_km2:", truth$area_km2),     "calibration: [2023-10-11, 2023-11-14]",     "validation: [2023-11-15, 2023-11-29]",     "wettest_years: 0"   ), file.path(folder, "basin.yml")) } list.files(basins) #> [1] "B01" "B02" "B03" "B04" "B05" "B06" "B07" "B08" cat(readLines(file.path(basins, "B01", "basin.yml")), sep = "\n") #> catchment: Example B01 #> gauge: B01 #> area_km2: 80 #> calibration: [2023-10-11, 2023-11-14] #> validation: [2023-11-15, 2023-11-29] #> wettest_years: 0

code: dists <- list(   Pareto = FlodeParetoCapacity(0, 140, 0.4),   Rectangular = FlodeRectangularCapacity(0, 200),   Triangular = FlodeTriangularCapacity(0, 200),   Exponential = FlodeExponentialCapacity(100),   Lognormal = FlodeLognormalCapacity(log(100) - 0.5, 1) ) cc <- seq(0, 300, length.out = 400) net <- seq(0, 200, length.out = 200) two_panels() plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 300), ylim = c(0, 1), xlab = "Store capacity c (mm)",      ylab = "Share of catchment below c", main = "Capacity distributions, mean 100 mm") for (i in seq_along(dists)) {   lines(cc, capacity_cdf(dists[[i]], cc), col = pal[i], lwd = 2, lty = i) } legend("bottomright", names(dists), col = pal, lty = 1:5, lwd = 2, bty = "n", cex = 0.8) plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 200), ylim = c(0, 160), xlab = "Net rainfall in one interval (mm)",      ylab = "Direct runoff (mm)", main = "Runoff from a storm, soil at 50 mm") abline(0, 1, col = "grey70", lty = 3) for (i in seq_along(dists)) {   runoff <- vapply(net, function(p) soil_step(dists[[i]], 50, p)$runoff, numeric(1))   lines(net, runoff, col = pal[i], lwd = 2, lty = i) }

code: n <- 24 * 25 rain <- rep(0, n) rain[24 * 2 + 1:12] <- 4 rain[24 * 9 + 1:6] <- 8 forcing <- data.frame(rain = rain, pet = 0.05) days <- seq_len(n) / 24 recharge <- list(   Standard = FlodeStandardRecharge(kg = 200, bg = 1, st = 0),   Split = FlodeSplitRecharge(alpha = 0.6),   Demand = FlodeDemandRecharge(alpha = 0.5, beta = 1.5, qsat = 0.4) ) runs <- lapply(recharge, function(r) {   model <- pdm_model(recharge = r, groundwater = cubic_routing(kb = 2000), area_km2 = 50)   state <- initial_state_from_flow(model, observed_m3s = 1, baseflow_fraction = 0.7,                                    soil_fraction = 0.6)   run_pdm(model, forcing, state)$output }) two_panels() plot(NA, xlim = range(days), ylim = c(0, max(sapply(runs, function(o) max(o$q_m3s)))),      xlab = "Day", ylab = "Flow (m3/s)", main = "Total flow") for (i in seq_along(runs)) lines(days, runs[[i]]$q_m3s, col = pal[i], lwd = 2, lty = i) legend("topright", names(runs), col = pal, lty = 1:3, lwd = 2, bty = "n", cex = 0.8) baseflow <- lapply(runs, function(o) o$baseflow_out_mm * 50 / 3.6) plot(NA, xlim = range(days), ylim = c(0, max(unlist(baseflow))), xlab = "Day",      ylab = "Baseflow (m3/s)", main = "Baseflow component") for (i in seq_along(runs)) lines(days, baseflow[[i]], col = pal[i], lwd = 2, lty = i)

code: routes <- list(   Linear = linear_routing(48), Quadratic = quadratic_routing(2000),   Cubic = cubic_routing(20000), Exponential = FlodeExponentialRouting(0.05, -2) ) hours <- 0:(24 * 20) two_panels() plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 20), ylim = c(0.01, 1), log = "y", xlab = "Day",      ylab = "Outflow (mm/h, log scale)", main = "Recession with no inflow") for (i in seq_along(routes)) {   r <- routes[[i]]   storage <- storage_for_flow(r, 1)   q <- numeric(length(hours))   q[1] <- 1   for (h in 2:length(hours)) {     step <- route_step(r, storage, 0, 1)     storage <- step$storage     q[h] <- step$q_end   }   lines(hours / 24, q, col = pal[i], lwd = 2, lty = i) } legend("bottomleft", names(routes), col = pal, lty = 1:4, lwd = 2, bty = "n", cex = 0.8) qq <- seq(0.001, 1, length.out = 200) plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), xlab = "Outflow q (mm/h)",      ylab = "Relative storage", main = "Storage needed for each outflow") for (i in seq_along(routes)) {   r <- routes[[i]]   low <- storage_for_flow(r, 0.001)   high <- storage_for_flow(r, 1)   lines(qq, (storage_for_flow(r, qq) - low) / (high - low), col = pal[i], lwd = 2, lty = i) }

code: set.seed(1) n15 <- 96 * 60 rain15 <- ifelse(stats::runif(n15) < 0.08, stats::rgamma(n15, 0.7, scale = 1), 0) steps <- c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 6, 12, 24) aggregate_steps <- function(x, k) colSums(matrix(x[seq_len(floor(length(x) / k) * k)], k)) smith_error <- function(kb) {   vapply(steps, function(dt) {     k <- dt / 0.25     f <- data.frame(rain = aggregate_steps(rain15, k), pet = 0.02 * k)     build <- function(solver, rtol = 1e-8) {       suppressWarnings(pdm_model(area_km2 = 50, dt = dt, groundwater = power_routing(         k = 1 / kb, m = 3, solver = solver, rtol = rtol, atol = 1e-12       )))     }     ref <- run_pdm(build("adaptive", 1e-12), f)$output$q_m3s     smith <- run_pdm(build("smith"), f)$output$q_m3s     100 * max(abs(smith - ref)) / max(ref)   }, numeric(1)) } kbs <- c(1000, 10000, 50000) errors <- sapply(kbs, smith_error) par(mar = c(4, 4, 1, 1)) matplot(steps, errors, type = "b", log = "xy", pch = 16, lty = 1, lwd = 2, col = pal[1:3],         xlab = "Time step (hours, log scale)", ylab = "Smith error, % of peak (log scale)",         yaxt = "n") axis(2, at = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100), labels = c("0.01", "0.1", "1", "10", "100"), las = 1) abline(v = 1, lty = 3, col = "grey50") legend("topleft", paste("kb =", format(kbs, big.mark = ",")), col = pal[1:3], lwd = 2,        pch = 16, bty = "n", cex = 0.8)

title: Catchment rainfall from gauges and radar
text: every method can checked truth, examples use made-catchment 40 km2 30 km grid 1 km cells. Storm cells drift across 600 time steps. Ten gauges record true rain small error. radar sees true pattern -reads 40% west -reads 20% east, noise cell cell. catchment_mask() marks grid cells whose centres lie inside catchment boundary, 42 .
code: set.seed(4) grid <- list(x = seq(500, 29500, by = 1000), y = seq(500, 29500, by = 1000)) nx <- length(grid$x) ny <- length(grid$y) steps <- 600 gx <- matrix(grid$x, nx, ny) gy <- matrix(grid$y, nx, ny, byrow = TRUE) truth <- array(0, c(nx, ny, steps)) for (k in 1:60) {   t0 <- sample.int(steps - 12, 1)   cx <- runif(1, 0, 30000)   cy <- runif(1, 0, 30000)   size <- runif(1, 2000, 6000)   peak <- rexp(1, 1 / 4)   for (s in 0:11) {     truth[, , t0 + s] <- truth[, , t0 + s] +       peak * exp(-((gx - cx - 800 * s)^2 + (gy - cy)^2) / (2 * size^2)) * exp(-s / 4)   } } bias <- 0.6 + 0.6 * gx / 30000 radar <- truth * as.vector(bias) * exp(rnorm(length(truth), 0, 0.25)) gauges <- data.frame(id = LETTERS[1:10], x = runif(10, 2000, 28000), y = runif(10, 2000, 28000)) at <- list(i = vapply(gauges$x, function(v) which.min(abs(grid$x - v)), 1L),            j = vapply(gauges$y, function(v) which.min(abs(grid$y - v)), 1L)) gauge_rain <- t(vapply(seq_len(steps), function(t) truth[cbind(at$i, at$j, t)], numeric(10))) *   exp(rnorm(steps * 10, 0, 0.05)) boundary <- data.frame(x = c(11000, 18000, 19000, 12000), y = c(11000, 10500, 17000, 17500)) mask <- catchment_mask(grid$x, grid$y, boundary) sum(mask) #> [1] 42

text: Methods. Every hindcast includes: default ar holds Environment Agency 2024 default set default-family set whose principal decay model's time peak response_flow, pdm_response_time(). 2024 default defined 15-minute steps; steps still applied, given, message. default family built 15-minute steps : longer steps, time peak 4.9 steps gives unstable set (see ar_from_response_time()), left warning. Errors observed minus simulated flow, m3/s, additive, IMFS. AR projection origin needs last three errors; observations missing, origin AR forecast. Updated flows lower_limit raised . leaks. simulation runs continuously without updating, forecast origin uses observations origin . AR coefficients come outside scored period: fixed sets, fit_window, calibration window. Fitting scored window let AR learn errors corrects.
